mechanism_narrative: Low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) consistently correlates with positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns, as low rates reduce discount rates and increase equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns in periods of FEDFUNDS < 0.5% are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 5-day returns as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns in periods of UNRATE rise > 0.3pp in 3 months are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) both fall below their 12-month moving averages, it signals a weakening consumer economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both below 12-month moving average
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns in periods of both HOUST and RSAFS below 12mo MA are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (defined by a 3-month rise in the federal funds rate exceeding 0.25 percentage points and annual CPI inflation above 2%), S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative due to reduced liquidity and increased risk aversion.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp in 3 months and CPIAUCSL annual inflation > 2%
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns in periods of FEDFUNDS rise > 0.25pp in 3 months and CPIAUCSL annual inflation > 2% are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 2% signals a weakening manufacturing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 5-day returns as investors anticipate reduced corporate profits.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns in periods of INDPRO fall > 2% in 3 months are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Low housing starts (HOUST below 1000 thousand units) consistently correlate with negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns, as weak housing activity signals a contracting economy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns in periods of HOUST < 1000 are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When annual inflation (as measured by CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.5%, S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative due to central bank tightening and reduced real returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns in periods of CPIAUCSL annual inflation > 2.5% are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When employment growth (PAYEMS) is below 0.5% and unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.0%, it signals a weak labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 5-day returns as investors anticipate reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns in periods of PAYEMS growth < 0.5% and UNRATE > 5.0% are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
